targets.title: Objects don’t object: Evidence that self-objectification disrupts women’s social activism
targets.evidence_quote: In 2013, Calogero found a negative link between self-objectification and collective action, which was mediated by the adoption of gender-specific system justification. Here, we report two preregistered direct replications (PDRs) of Calogero’s original study.
targets.outcome_quote: Results of the two PDRs, in which we used a Bayesian approach, supported the null hypothesis.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The two direct replications support no link, contrary to the original positive self-objectification–system justification relationship and mediation claim. This is the authors’ aggregate verdict.

reasoning: Two completed preregistered new-sample tests of the Calogero 2013 finding. Meta-analysis inputs and scale-development papers are not separate targets.
